feature: Automatic per-node history compaction with preserved execution archives
capacity_source: Provider model metadata, scoped by endpoint and model

direct_private_access_audit.finding: Accesses belong to same-class instances or the public namedtuple _replace API; no direct foreign private-field access found.

ownership_changes: HistoryArchive owns replacement records and turn boundaries for root and children; callers use snapshots and commands.
HistoryCompactionPolicy separates before_inference decisions from after_compaction notification.
CompactionResult owns retained-message projection; NodeRuntime no longer reconstructs identity from index-map internals.
MessageHistory owns occurrence-aware rollback; Client and NodeRuntime share the public removal API.
TurnStreamCollector owns copying incoming model-context checkpoints.
corrected_behaviors: Child replay and Raw Current include messages recorded after the latest compact-context checkpoint.
Context views do not share mutable saved history with their callers.
Metadata probes cache capacity against the actual endpoint, including explicit alternate probes and stale responses.
DS4 scope checkpoints are tracked for root and children independently of UI observers.
Rollback of repeated message objects preserves occurrences already accepted by the provider.
DS4 estimates literal client prompts after server guidance removal in 04e8e1c; obsolete injected-prefix state and guidance resources are removed.
The Qwen38 static gate checks capability validation and sampling rather than requiring the removed server guidance function.

mock_and_browser_scenarios: Threshold boundary, configurable value and persistence
Unknown server capacity and endpoint isolation
DS4 preflight matches literal server prompt without synthetic scope instructions
Repeated compaction and prevention of duplicate calls in Raw
Preservation of original tool arguments, outputs and graph nodes
Checkpoint serialization and continuation from compact context
Recovery of original output after runtime reconstruction
Nested skills and native return metadata
Steering accepted during compaction and delivered before inference
Summary/scoring failure, cancellation and rejected input rollback
Optional observers and final checkpoint completeness
User images preserved through compaction and replay
Raw switch with pointer, keyboard and a 390px viewport
Switch and page reload while compaction is paused
limits: No live model-provider or GPU performance qualification was run for this change.
Protected system/user messages and active scope anchors can prevent reduction below the threshold.
Coverage follows the repositories' existing configured inclusions; frontend UI is additionally checked through Playwright and screenshots.
The cross-repository private-access scan and targeted review are not a formal proof of every clean-code property; existing large coordination modules were not rewritten wholesale.
